jobs.title: Vice President of Finance
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

**ELEVATE SERVICE GROUP INC.**


TSX\-V: SERV \| Toronto, Ontario

**Vice President, Finance**

**Reports To:** Chief Financial Officer

**Location:**


Burlington, Ontario (hybrid — head office based, with travel to operating subsidiary sites in the GTA, SW ON and other Canadian markets as required)

**Direct Reports:**


Controller(s), FP\&A and accounting staff — team expected to grow in line with acquisition pace

**Employment Type:**


Full\-time, permanent

**Target Base Salary: CAD $180,000 – $220,000, commensurate with experience**

**Total Target Compensation: CAD $220,000 – $290,000\+ (base \+ short\-term incentive \+ long\-term incentive)**

**About Elevate Service Group**


Elevate Service Group Inc. (TSX\-V: SERV) is a Toronto\-based, publicly listed holding company building a national platform in facilities management and essential commercial services. Elevate acquires and integrates well\-run, founder\-led businesses that provide electrical services, plumbing, equipment repair, grease trap maintenance, general repairs and renovations, preventative maintenance, and technology\-enabled facilities solutions to national retailers, restaurant chains, and property managers across Canada.


The company currently operates six subsidiaries — Infinity Group Construction, First Choice Maintenance, Charged Electric Services, Think Green Solutions, JJ\&A Mechanical, and TFI Food Equipment Solutions — and is executing a disciplined roll\-up acquisition strategy targeting three to six acquisitions per year. Elevate is currently generating approximately $25 million in EBITDA and has recently upsized a bought\-deal equity offering and secured a term sheet for a $25 million acquisition facility to accelerate this strategy. This is a high\-growth, high\-velocity environment: the finance function is being built in real time alongside the platform it supports.

**Position Summary**


Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer, the Vice President, Finance is the senior finance executive responsible for the operational and technical backbone of the finance function across the Elevate platform. This is a hands\-on leadership role spanning financial planning \& analysis, consolidated public company reporting, treasury and credit facility management, and — critically — the financial due diligence and integration work that underpins a 3\-to\-6\-acquisition\-per\-year roll\-up strategy. The successful candidate will build repeatable processes and a scalable finance organization capable of absorbing new subsidiaries quickly and cleanly while maintaining the reporting discipline expected of a TSX Venture\-listed issuer.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Financial Planning \& Analysis / Corporate Finance**

* Own consolidated budgeting, forecasting, and long\-range financial planning across the holding company and all operating subsidiaries.
* Build and maintain financial models supporting acquisition evaluation, capital allocation decisions, and organic growth initiatives.
* Prepare monthly and quarterly management reporting packages, KPI dashboards, and variance analysis for the CEO, CFO, and Board of Directors.
* Partner with operating company presidents and general managers on budget\-to\-actual performance, margin improvement, and working capital initiatives.

**M\&A / Roll\-Up Execution \& Integration**

* Lead financial due diligence workstreams on acquisition targets, including quality of earnings analysis, working capital assessment, and normalized EBITDA calculations.
* Partner with the CFO, CEO, and external advisors on deal structuring, purchase price allocation, and closing mechanics.
* Own the post\-close financial integration playbook for each newly acquired business — chart of accounts mapping, accounting system onboarding, payroll and banking transition, and internal controls uplift.
* Track and report on acquisition synergies, integration costs, and post\-close performance against the original deal model.
* Continuously refine a repeatable, scalable acquisition\-to\-integration playbook capable of supporting three to six acquisitions per year.

**Consolidated Financial Reporting \& Public Company Compliance**

* Oversee consolidation of financial results across all operating subsidiaries under IFRS, with the subsidiary count expected to grow each year.
* Own preparation of quarterly and annual financial statements, MD\&A, and other continuous disclosure filings in coordination with the CFO, external auditors, and legal counsel.
* Ensure compliance with TSX Venture Exchange listing requirements, applicable Canadian securities law, and NI 51\-102 continuous disclosure obligations.
* Support the CFO and Audit Committee with quarterly reporting packages, technical accounting memos, and audit committee materials.
* Manage the year\-end audit process and day\-to\-day relationship with the company's external auditors.

**Treasury, Banking \& Credit Facility Management**

* Manage consolidated cash flow forecasting and working capital across the group.
* Own banking relationships and administer the company's credit facilities, including the acquisition facility, ensuring ongoing covenant compliance and timely lender reporting.
* Support capital markets activity (equity financings, debt facilities) with financial modeling, data room preparation, and lender/investor due diligence materials.

**Accounting Operations, Controls \& Systems**

* Build and scale accounting policies, procedures, and internal controls appropriate for a growing multi\-entity public company.
* Standardize the chart of accounts, month\-end close process, and reporting timelines across all operating subsidiaries.
* Lead the selection and implementation of consolidation and ERP systems to support the platform as it scales.
* Coordinate corporate tax, HST/GST, and payroll tax compliance across all entities with external tax advisors.

jobs.title: Head of Sales ZEISS Medical Technology - Microsurgery
jobs.description:
**About Us:**

ZEISS is a global technology and innovation leader in optics and optoelectronics. Founded in Germany in 1846, ZEISS operates in 50\+ countries and offers career opportunities across engineering, manufacturing, research, sales, and technology.


As a foundation\-owned company, ZEISS is committed to responsibility, quality, and continuous innovation. Employees help shape the future through cutting\-edge technology and impactful work. With a strong North American presence since 1925 and 20\+ locations, ZEISS partners with industries including semiconductor, automotive, biomedical research, and medical technology, and is a leading manufacturer of eyeglass lenses, camera and cinema lenses, and precision optical systems.  



  

**What’s the role?**

The Head of Sales ZEISS Medical Technology Microsurgery is responsible for leading the commercial strategy, sales execution, market development, customer engagement, and overall business performance of the Microsurgery business across Canada. The incumbent is accountable for achieving revenue, profitability, market share, and growth objectives while ensuring alignment with ZEISS Canada priorities and the broader Microsurgery strategy across the Americas region.


The role provides leadership across key microsurgical specialties, including Neurosurgery, Otolaryngology (ENT), Spine, Radiation Oncology, Dental, and other emerging clinical segments. Working within a matrix environment, the incumbent collaborates closely with Americas Microsurgery leadership, ZEISS Canada leadership, Marketing, Clinical Applications, Service, Finance, and other key stakeholders to drive sustainable business growth and exceptional customer experiences.


The Head of Sales leads, coaches, and develops a team of Account Managers, fostering a culture of accountability, customer focus, commercial excellence, and continuous development. As a player\-coach, the incumbent remains actively engaged in strategic account management, executive customer relationships, major capital equipment opportunities, complex negotiations, Requests for Proposal (RFPs), and other key business pursuits while providing leadership and coaching to the commercial team.


The incumbent leverages Salesforce and commercial analytics to drive forecasting accuracy, pipeline visibility, account planning, business insights, and sales performance across the Canadian Microsurgery business  



  

**Sound interesting?**

**Here's what you'll do.**

  

***Business Strategy \& Market Development***

  

* Develop and execute the Canadian Microsurgery commercial strategy in alignment with regional and global business objectives.
* Identify and evaluate market trends, customer needs, competitive activities and emerging opportunities.
* Maintain a comprehensive understanding of the installed base of microsurgical technologies across Canadian healthcare institutions.
* Identify upgrade, replacement and expansion opportunities through analysis of customer equipment inventories, utilization trends and technology lifecycles.
* Develop business plans to increase market penetration and market share.
* Identify new customer segments and growth opportunities across Canada.
Recommend strategic initiatives that support sustainable business growth.  
* 

  

***Sales Leadership \& Business Performance***

  

* Lead all Microsurgery sales activities across Canada.
* Deliver annual revenue, profitability and market share targets.
* Drive execution of national sales plans and strategic initiatives.
* Operate as a player\-coach by providing sales leadership, mentoring and performance management while maintaining personal involvement in strategic customer relationships, major opportunities and complex sales pursuits.
* Monitor pipeline health, forecasting accuracy and sales performance metrics.
* Ensure effective utilization of CRM and commercial excellence tools.
* Drive a disciplined sales management process through effective utilization of Salesforce CRM, ensuring data integrity, forecast accuracy, pipeline transparency and opportunity progression.
* Establish and monitor key sales performance indicators, including pipeline coverage, win rates, sales cycle duration, forecasting accuracy, account penetration and market share growth.
* Leverage Salesforce analytics and reporting tools to identify trends, manage risk, assess territory performance and drive informed business decisions.
* Ensure timely and accurate maintenance of customer, opportunity, quotation and competitive information within Salesforce.
* Lead long\-term capital equipment opportunity planning and sales execution activities to support sustainable revenue growth.
* Monitor sales cycle progression and resource requirements for large strategic opportunities.
* Lead monthly business reviews and performance discussions.
Develop and monitor annual budgets and forecasts.  
* 

  

***Customer \& Stakeholder Management***

  

* Build and maintain executive\-level relationships with key customers and healthcare stakeholders.
* Develop strategic account plans for major customers and institutions.
* Increase customer engagement and strengthen long\-term partnerships.
* Partner with service and application teams to ensure excellent customer support.
Represent ZEISS at industry events, conferences and professional associations.  
* 

  

***Strategic Accounts \& RFP Management***

* Lead complex capital equipment sales opportunities from prospecting through proposal development, contract negotiation, installation and post\-sale follow\-up.

* Monitor hospital capital planning cycles, procurement initiatives and funding opportunities to proactively position ZEISS solutions.

jobs.description:
### **Description**

  

**What we do every day to be our very best**  

Every day at Securian Canada means a day spent helping Canadians and their families build secure tomorrows. We’re agile and innovative, and we aren't afraid to challenge and create, or bring diverse perspectives to our work.
  

  

**Who we need**  

  

As our **Director, Analytics \& Insights**, you'll help shape how data drives decisions across Securian Canada.  

We're looking for a leader who sees beyond dashboards and reports. Someone who is energized by complex business challenges, naturally curious about what drives performance, and passionate about transforming data into meaningful business outcomes. You'll play a pivotal role in **building and evolving an enterprise analytics capability** that empowers leaders with **trusted insights, scalable analytics products, modern business intelligence, and practical AI\-enabled solutions**.  

Reporting to the AVP, Data Solutions, you'll lead a **multidisciplinary team** responsible for Analytics \& Insights, Business Intelligence, and Analytics Engineering. Working across business and technology teams, you'll help create a shared understanding of customers, products, markets, financial performance, and organizational priorities, enabling smarter decisions at every level of the organization.  

This opportunity is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing **strategic thinking with hands\-on leadership**. You'll **influence enterprise priorities**, guide complex analytical initiatives, challenge assumptions, and help leaders translate insights into action.  

The leader we're looking for combines strong **business judgment with technical depth**. You start with the decision that needs to be made, not the tool that will be used. You understand that **data and analytics are strategic business assets** and know how to balance immediate business needs with scalable enterprise solutions. You're pragmatic, collaborative, governance\-minded, and skilled at translating complex analytical concepts into compelling business narratives that drive action.  

Most importantly, you're passionate about **building high\-performing teams**, **developing talent**, fostering collaboration, and creating an environment where people can do their best work while **making a meaningful impact**.  

At Securian Canada, analytics is about more than understanding what happened. It's about helping people make better decisions that support our mission of helping Canadians and their families build secure tomorrows. You'll join a team of talented professionals who are committed to innovation, continuous improvement, and creating solutions that make a real difference across our business.  

The base salary range for this position is between $130,000 to $170,000 depending on experience. Details of our additional benefits are outlined below. This job posting is for an existing vacancy. Only one position is available. However, it may be based in multiple locations: Toronto (ON), or Waterloo (ON), or Montreal (QC).### **What you will do**

  

* Define and execute an analytics and insights roadmap aligned with enterprise, market, customer, and partner priorities.
* Transform strategic business questions into actionable analytical opportunities, KPI frameworks, data requirements, and decision\-support solutions.
* Deliver meaningful insights into business performance, customer behaviour, claims experience, product results, portfolio trends, operational effectiveness, and emerging risks.
* Translate complex findings into clear recommendations and executive\-ready narratives that drive informed decision\-making.
* Establish scalable practices that improve prioritization, delivery, adoption, value realization, and continuous improvement.
* Lead the evolution from fragmented reporting toward trusted, enterprise\-scale analytics products.
* Oversee the development of curated datasets, semantic models, certified metrics, dashboards, scorecards, and client\-facing reporting solutions.
* Partner with Data Pipeline Engineering, Technology, Governance, Finance, and business leaders to strengthen analytics foundations and support critical business priorities.
* Improve self\-service analytics capabilities while reducing manual effort, duplicated logic, and disconnected solutions.
* Ensure analytics products are scalable, reliable, understandable, and centered around real business decisions.
* Identify practical opportunities where advanced analytics, machine learning, predictive modeling, and AI can create measurable business value.
* Prioritize initiatives based on business impact, data readiness, adoption potential, and long\-term sustainability.
* Establish governance, controls, explainability, data quality standards, and operating requirements needed to support responsible AI and advanced analytics.
* Guide innovative solutions from ideation through implementation, ensuring clear ownership, measurable outcomes, and long\-term success.
* Lead, coach, and inspire a team of professionals across analytics, insights, business intelligence, reporting, and analytics engineering.
* Foster a culture focused on analytical excellence, collaboration, accountability, continuous learning, and business partnership.
* Provide guidance on analytical problem solving, data\-product design, storytelling, and stakeholder engagement.
* Help team members grow beyond traditional reporting by strengthening skills in problem framing, root\-cause analysis, insight generation, and strategic recommendations.
* Create an environment where innovation, curiosity, and measurable business outcomes are valued and celebrated.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders, helping connect business priorities to data\-driven solutions.
* Build strong relationships across Data Solutions, Technology, Finance, Operations, and business teams.
* Influence decision\-making by bringing clarity, insight, and strategic perspective to complex challenges.

Requisition ID: 274859
  

  

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high\-performing culture.

  



**Role**  

The Director of Data Delivery leads and empowers the teams responsible for the end\-to\-end, Agile delivery of data solutions and data products on the Azure/Databricks platform for International Banking, serving all business lines. This role owns delivery across the full lifecycle—data ingestion, provisioning, engineering, and productization—while ensuring strong governance, regulatory compliance, and strategic alignment. The Director provides senior leadership to Agile Delivery Managers, Project Managers, and cross\-functional engineering teams, and partners with architecture, platform, and business stakeholders to scale a consistent, reusable Azure/Databricks delivery model across all International Banking markets and business lines.  

**Is this role right for you? In this role you will:**  

* **Delivery of Solutions \& Data Products on Azure/Databricks:** Lead the Agile, end\-to\-end delivery of data solutions and data products—pipelines, Delta/Lakehouse datasets, analytics platforms, and reporting tools—built on Azure/Databricks for all International Banking business lines, ensuring engineering best practices, reusability, and alignment with business objectives.
* **Azure/Databricks Platform Enablement:** Partner with architecture and platform teams to establish and scale Azure/Databricks workspaces, Unity Catalog, and declarative/Lakeflow pipelines as the standard delivery foundation, driving a consistent, secure, and cost\-efficient operating model across all International Banking markets and business lines.
* **Governance and Compliance:** Ensure all data products and initiatives adhere to international banking regulations, data governance frameworks, and internal compliance policies, maintaining the highest standards of security and regulatory compliance.
* **Management of Data Delivery Projects Across All Business Lines:** Direct and manage data provisioning, ingestion, and product\-delivery initiatives spanning every International Banking business line, coordinating resources, timelines, and deliverables to achieve strategic goals on the Azure/Databricks platform.
* **Leadership for Agile Delivery Managers:** Lead, mentor, and develop Agile Delivery Managers, fostering a high\-performing, collaborative culture and driving professional growth.
* **Leadership for Data Project Managers:** Provide strategic direction and support to Project Managers, ensuring effective project execution and alignment with organizational priorities.
* **Data Strategy and Planning:** Shape and execute the data strategy, leveraging emerging technologies and industry trends to enhance banking operations and maintain a competitive edge.
* **Support for Data Ops, Data Ingestion, and Data Provisioning Teams:** Collaborate with Data Ops, Data Ingestion, and Data Provisioning teams, providing planning and facilitation services to optimize Azure/Databricks workflows (CI/CD and DataOps), resolve impediments, and enable seamless, reliable delivery across all business lines.
* **Stakeholder Engagement:** Act as the primary point of contact for senior stakeholders, translating business needs into actionable data initiatives and ensuring expectations are met through clear communication and robust reporting.
* **Performance Metrics and Continuous Improvement:** Define and monitor KPIs (delivery velocity, data quality, team productivity, stakeholder satisfaction) to drive process optimization and operational excellence.
* **Innovation:** Champion a culture of innovation, leveraging Azure/Databricks capabilities, Lakehouse architecture, Delta Lake, and AI/ML, to deliver impactful, scalable data solutions and products for International Banking.
  

  

**Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We'd love to work with you if you have:****Education:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Master’s degree (e.g., MBA, MS in Data Science) or advanced certifications (e.g., Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), SAFe Program Consultant (SPC), PMP) strongly preferred.

  

**Experience:**
* Minimum 10 years of progressive experience in Agile project management, data product delivery, and data strategy within banking or financial services.
* At least 5 years in a senior leadership role overseeing Agile Delivery Managers, Project Managers, and cross\-functional data teams.
* Demonstrated success delivering data solutions and data products on Azure/Databricks (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, pipelines), including leadership of Data Ops, Data Ingestion, and Data Provisioning functions.
* Proven track record of implementing governance and compliance frameworks for data products, ensuring adherence to international regulations (e.g., GDPR, Basel III, MiFID II).
* Extensive experience engaging with C\-level stakeholders, translating business needs into actionable data initiatives, and driving stakeholder alignment.
* Strong background in planning and facilitation services for technical teams, optimizing workflows, and resolving impediments.

  

**Skills \& Competencies:**
* Expert knowledge of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) and modern data engineering on Azure/Databricks, including the Lakehouse architecture, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, declarative/Lakeflow pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, and data governance.
* Exceptional leadership and mentoring abilities, with a focus on developing high\-performing Agile Delivery Managers and Project Managers.
* Strategic thinking and planning skills, with the ability to shape and execute data strategy and drive innovation.
* Advanced stakeholder management and communication skills, capable of influencing senior executives and global teams.

**What is the Opportunity?**


RBC's Global Payments Technology organization is modernizing international payments infrastructure across real\-time payments, cross\-border transactions, debit cards, ACH, and emerging payment channels. We're now scaling AI capabilities to enhance fraud detection, optimize payment routing, improve transaction monitoring, and drive operational efficiency across our global payments ecosystem.


We're seeking an exceptional delivery leader to orchestrate multiple large AI programs within Global Payments Technology while establishing AI\-native delivery practices that respect the security, compliance, and reliability demands of mission\-critical payments systems.


As Director, AI Delivery \& Portfolio Management – Global Payments Technology, you will lead a strategic portfolio of AI initiatives across research, engineering, platform, and business teams. You will drive alignment across complex programs, champion modern AI delivery methodologies, and ensure program management evolves to embrace AI's iterative nature while maintaining stringent operational and regulatory standards.


Reporting to the Senior Director, Program Delivery, you will own end\-to\-end delivery accountability for this strategic AI portfolio while establishing AI SDLC standards that shape how RBC delivers AI solutions for payments at scale.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Enterprise Systems & AI Enablement
jobs.description:
**The Company**

 **Cineflix Media**



Cineflix creates, produces, and distributes must\-watch TV for global platforms, with operations in Montreal, Toronto, Vancouver, New York, Los Angeles, London, and Dublin. A leading international media company, the group includes top\-ranking sales and acquisitions division, Cineflix Rights, as well as production labels Buccaneer and C3 Media. With a catalogue of 7,600 hours of select programming across a wide range of genres and a collection of YouTube and FAST channels streaming 24/7, Cineflix is behind some of TV’s most popular and long\-running shows.

  


**The Role**



Cineflix Media is seeking a Senior Director, Enterprise Systems \& AI Enablement to lead the practical implementation of our enterprise AI and technology transformation agenda.



This cross\-functional role will work across the organisation to identify opportunities, modernise systems, redesign processes and embed effective AI\-enabled ways of working.

  



Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, the Senior Director will partner closely with IT and leaders across Cineflix to translate business priorities into practical, measurable outcomes. Initial areas of focus may include Cineflix’s finance, rights management, production budgeting, payroll and planning systems, but the scope of the role extends across the organisation. This is a full\-time role based in our Toronto, Ontario office on a hybrid, in\-office schedule.

  



The Salary range for this role is CAD $150,000 \- $200,000

  


**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Lead the implementation of Cineflix’s enterprise AI agenda across corporate and operational functions.
* Identify and prioritise practical AI and automation opportunities that improve productivity, accuracy and decision\-making.
* Translate business requirements into scalable AI\-enabled solutions and workflows.
* Lead the development and deployment of Cineflix\-owned LLM capability for internal processes, reducing reliance on external tools and ensuring solutions are tailored to Cineflix’s workflows, data, security and governance requirements.
* Establish responsible AI practices in partnership with IT, Legal, Privacy and business leaders.
* Collaborate with Creative AI leadership to align governance while maintaining clear areas of accountability.
* Develop and deliver a roadmap for modernising, connecting and, where appropriate, consolidating Cineflix’s core business systems.
* Improve the quality, accessibility and governance of enterprise data.
* Reduce reliance on manual processes, disconnected systems and uncontrolled spreadsheets.
* Lead systems integration, automation and modernisation initiatives in partnership with IT and functional leaders.
* Evaluate technology partners and solutions based on business value, security, scalability and cost.
* Lead the successful adoption of new systems, AI tools and redesigned processes.
* Partner with business leaders and HR to support communications, training and skills development.
* Help teams understand and adapt to changing roles, responsibilities and ways of working.
* Build shared ownership across functions and address barriers to adoption and measure implementation progress, employee adoption and realised business benefits.

  


**Experience and Capabilities**

  

* Senior experience in enterprise technology, AI enablement, business systems or digital transformation.
* Demonstrated success implementing practical AI, automation and workflow solutions.
* Experience leading complex, cross\-functional transformation programmes.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise systems, data governance, cybersecurity and vendor management.
* The ability to connect business needs with practical technology solutions.
* Strong stakeholder management, change leadership and communication skills.
* A collaborative, pragmatic and execution\-focused leadership style.
* Experience in media, entertainment, production or another project\-based organisation would be an asset.

  



This posting reflects an existing vacancy. Cineflix does not use artificial intelligence in the screening, assessment, or selection of applicants for this role.

  

If you are interested in this opportunity, please send your resume and cover letter to the Director, Human Resources, Mackenzie Graham via the provided link. No phone calls please. We thank all applicants, but only those selected will be contacted.

  

Cineflix Media is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a diverse environment. Cineflix welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

**What we do every day to be our very best**  

Every day at Securian Canada means a day spent helping Canadians and their families build secure tomorrows. We’re agile and innovative, and we aren't afraid to challenge and create, or bring diverse perspectives to our work.
  

  

**Who we need**  

  

As our **Director, Analytics \& Insights**, you'll help shape how data drives decisions across Securian Canada.  

We're looking for a leader who sees beyond dashboards and reports. Someone who is energized by complex business challenges, naturally curious about what drives performance, and passionate about transforming data into meaningful business outcomes. You'll play a pivotal role in **building and evolving an enterprise analytics capability** that empowers leaders with **trusted insights, scalable analytics products, modern business intelligence, and practical AI\-enabled solutions**.  

Reporting to the AVP, Data Solutions, you'll lead a **multidisciplinary team** responsible for Analytics \& Insights, Business Intelligence, and Analytics Engineering. Working across business and technology teams, you'll help create a shared understanding of customers, products, markets, financial performance, and organizational priorities, enabling smarter decisions at every level of the organization.  

This opportunity is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing **strategic thinking with hands\-on leadership**. You'll **influence enterprise priorities**, guide complex analytical initiatives, challenge assumptions, and help leaders translate insights into action.  

The leader we're looking for combines strong **business judgment with technical depth**. You start with the decision that needs to be made, not the tool that will be used. You understand that **data and analytics are strategic business assets** and know how to balance immediate business needs with scalable enterprise solutions. You're pragmatic, collaborative, governance\-minded, and skilled at translating complex analytical concepts into compelling business narratives that drive action.  

Most importantly, you're passionate about **building high\-performing teams**, **developing talent**, fostering collaboration, and creating an environment where people can do their best work while **making a meaningful impact**.  

At Securian Canada, analytics is about more than understanding what happened. It's about helping people make better decisions that support our mission of helping Canadians and their families build secure tomorrows. You'll join a team of talented professionals who are committed to innovation, continuous improvement, and creating solutions that make a real difference across our business.  

The base salary range for this position is between $130,000 to $170,000 depending on experience. Details of our additional benefits are outlined below. This job posting is for an existing vacancy. Only one position is available. However, it may be based in multiple locations: Toronto (ON), or Waterloo (ON), or Montreal (QC).### **What you will do**

  

* Define and execute an analytics and insights roadmap aligned with enterprise, market, customer, and partner priorities.
* Transform strategic business questions into actionable analytical opportunities, KPI frameworks, data requirements, and decision\-support solutions.
* Deliver meaningful insights into business performance, customer behaviour, claims experience, product results, portfolio trends, operational effectiveness, and emerging risks.
* Translate complex findings into clear recommendations and executive\-ready narratives that drive informed decision\-making.
* Establish scalable practices that improve prioritization, delivery, adoption, value realization, and continuous improvement.
* Lead the evolution from fragmented reporting toward trusted, enterprise\-scale analytics products.
* Oversee the development of curated datasets, semantic models, certified metrics, dashboards, scorecards, and client\-facing reporting solutions.
* Partner with Data Pipeline Engineering, Technology, Governance, Finance, and business leaders to strengthen analytics foundations and support critical business priorities.
* Improve self\-service analytics capabilities while reducing manual effort, duplicated logic, and disconnected solutions.
* Ensure analytics products are scalable, reliable, understandable, and centered around real business decisions.
* Identify practical opportunities where advanced analytics, machine learning, predictive modeling, and AI can create measurable business value.
* Prioritize initiatives based on business impact, data readiness, adoption potential, and long\-term sustainability.
* Establish governance, controls, explainability, data quality standards, and operating requirements needed to support responsible AI and advanced analytics.
* Guide innovative solutions from ideation through implementation, ensuring clear ownership, measurable outcomes, and long\-term success.
* Lead, coach, and inspire a team of professionals across analytics, insights, business intelligence, reporting, and analytics engineering.
* Foster a culture focused on analytical excellence, collaboration, accountability, continuous learning, and business partnership.
* Provide guidance on analytical problem solving, data\-product design, storytelling, and stakeholder engagement.
* Help team members grow beyond traditional reporting by strengthening skills in problem framing, root\-cause analysis, insight generation, and strategic recommendations.
* Create an environment where innovation, curiosity, and measurable business outcomes are valued and celebrated.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders, helping connect business priorities to data\-driven solutions.
* Build strong relationships across Data Solutions, Technology, Finance, Operations, and business teams.
* Influence decision\-making by bringing clarity, insight, and strategic perspective to complex challenges.

new_jobs.title: Head of Sales ZEISS Medical Technology - Microsurgery
new_jobs.description:
**About Us:**

ZEISS is a global technology and innovation leader in optics and optoelectronics. Founded in Germany in 1846, ZEISS operates in 50\+ countries and offers career opportunities across engineering, manufacturing, research, sales, and technology.


As a foundation\-owned company, ZEISS is committed to responsibility, quality, and continuous innovation. Employees help shape the future through cutting\-edge technology and impactful work. With a strong North American presence since 1925 and 20\+ locations, ZEISS partners with industries including semiconductor, automotive, biomedical research, and medical technology, and is a leading manufacturer of eyeglass lenses, camera and cinema lenses, and precision optical systems.  



  

**What’s the role?**

The Head of Sales ZEISS Medical Technology Microsurgery is responsible for leading the commercial strategy, sales execution, market development, customer engagement, and overall business performance of the Microsurgery business across Canada. The incumbent is accountable for achieving revenue, profitability, market share, and growth objectives while ensuring alignment with ZEISS Canada priorities and the broader Microsurgery strategy across the Americas region.


The role provides leadership across key microsurgical specialties, including Neurosurgery, Otolaryngology (ENT), Spine, Radiation Oncology, Dental, and other emerging clinical segments. Working within a matrix environment, the incumbent collaborates closely with Americas Microsurgery leadership, ZEISS Canada leadership, Marketing, Clinical Applications, Service, Finance, and other key stakeholders to drive sustainable business growth and exceptional customer experiences.


The Head of Sales leads, coaches, and develops a team of Account Managers, fostering a culture of accountability, customer focus, commercial excellence, and continuous development. As a player\-coach, the incumbent remains actively engaged in strategic account management, executive customer relationships, major capital equipment opportunities, complex negotiations, Requests for Proposal (RFPs), and other key business pursuits while providing leadership and coaching to the commercial team.


The incumbent leverages Salesforce and commercial analytics to drive forecasting accuracy, pipeline visibility, account planning, business insights, and sales performance across the Canadian Microsurgery business  



  

**Sound interesting?**

**Here's what you'll do.**

  

***Business Strategy \& Market Development***

  

* Develop and execute the Canadian Microsurgery commercial strategy in alignment with regional and global business objectives.
* Identify and evaluate market trends, customer needs, competitive activities and emerging opportunities.
* Maintain a comprehensive understanding of the installed base of microsurgical technologies across Canadian healthcare institutions.
* Identify upgrade, replacement and expansion opportunities through analysis of customer equipment inventories, utilization trends and technology lifecycles.
* Develop business plans to increase market penetration and market share.
* Identify new customer segments and growth opportunities across Canada.
Recommend strategic initiatives that support sustainable business growth.  
* 

  

***Sales Leadership \& Business Performance***

  

* Lead all Microsurgery sales activities across Canada.
* Deliver annual revenue, profitability and market share targets.
* Drive execution of national sales plans and strategic initiatives.
* Operate as a player\-coach by providing sales leadership, mentoring and performance management while maintaining personal involvement in strategic customer relationships, major opportunities and complex sales pursuits.
* Monitor pipeline health, forecasting accuracy and sales performance metrics.
* Ensure effective utilization of CRM and commercial excellence tools.
* Drive a disciplined sales management process through effective utilization of Salesforce CRM, ensuring data integrity, forecast accuracy, pipeline transparency and opportunity progression.
* Establish and monitor key sales performance indicators, including pipeline coverage, win rates, sales cycle duration, forecasting accuracy, account penetration and market share growth.
* Leverage Salesforce analytics and reporting tools to identify trends, manage risk, assess territory performance and drive informed business decisions.
* Ensure timely and accurate maintenance of customer, opportunity, quotation and competitive information within Salesforce.
* Lead long\-term capital equipment opportunity planning and sales execution activities to support sustainable revenue growth.
* Monitor sales cycle progression and resource requirements for large strategic opportunities.
* Lead monthly business reviews and performance discussions.
Develop and monitor annual budgets and forecasts.  
* 

  

***Customer \& Stakeholder Management***

  

* Build and maintain executive\-level relationships with key customers and healthcare stakeholders.
* Develop strategic account plans for major customers and institutions.
* Increase customer engagement and strengthen long\-term partnerships.
* Partner with service and application teams to ensure excellent customer support.
Represent ZEISS at industry events, conferences and professional associations.  
* 

  

***Strategic Accounts \& RFP Management***

* Lead complex capital equipment sales opportunities from prospecting through proposal development, contract negotiation, installation and post\-sale follow\-up.
* Direct Requests for Proposal (RFP), Requests for Quotation (RFQ), public tender and Group Purchasing Organization (GPO) opportunities across Canada.
* Develop winning bid strategies and coordinate cross\-functional support to deliver high\-quality customer proposals.
* Monitor hospital capital planning cycles, procurement initiatives and funding opportunities to proactively position ZEISS solutions.

new_jobs.title: Director, Agile Data Delivery
new_jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 274859
  

  

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high\-performing culture.

  



**Role**  

The Director of Data Delivery leads and empowers the teams responsible for the end\-to\-end, Agile delivery of data solutions and data products on the Azure/Databricks platform for International Banking, serving all business lines. This role owns delivery across the full lifecycle—data ingestion, provisioning, engineering, and productization—while ensuring strong governance, regulatory compliance, and strategic alignment. The Director provides senior leadership to Agile Delivery Managers, Project Managers, and cross\-functional engineering teams, and partners with architecture, platform, and business stakeholders to scale a consistent, reusable Azure/Databricks delivery model across all International Banking markets and business lines.  

**Is this role right for you? In this role you will:**  

* **Delivery of Solutions \& Data Products on Azure/Databricks:** Lead the Agile, end\-to\-end delivery of data solutions and data products—pipelines, Delta/Lakehouse datasets, analytics platforms, and reporting tools—built on Azure/Databricks for all International Banking business lines, ensuring engineering best practices, reusability, and alignment with business objectives.
* **Azure/Databricks Platform Enablement:** Partner with architecture and platform teams to establish and scale Azure/Databricks workspaces, Unity Catalog, and declarative/Lakeflow pipelines as the standard delivery foundation, driving a consistent, secure, and cost\-efficient operating model across all International Banking markets and business lines.
* **Governance and Compliance:** Ensure all data products and initiatives adhere to international banking regulations, data governance frameworks, and internal compliance policies, maintaining the highest standards of security and regulatory compliance.
* **Management of Data Delivery Projects Across All Business Lines:** Direct and manage data provisioning, ingestion, and product\-delivery initiatives spanning every International Banking business line, coordinating resources, timelines, and deliverables to achieve strategic goals on the Azure/Databricks platform.
* **Leadership for Agile Delivery Managers:** Lead, mentor, and develop Agile Delivery Managers, fostering a high\-performing, collaborative culture and driving professional growth.
* **Leadership for Data Project Managers:** Provide strategic direction and support to Project Managers, ensuring effective project execution and alignment with organizational priorities.
* **Data Strategy and Planning:** Shape and execute the data strategy, leveraging emerging technologies and industry trends to enhance banking operations and maintain a competitive edge.
* **Support for Data Ops, Data Ingestion, and Data Provisioning Teams:** Collaborate with Data Ops, Data Ingestion, and Data Provisioning teams, providing planning and facilitation services to optimize Azure/Databricks workflows (CI/CD and DataOps), resolve impediments, and enable seamless, reliable delivery across all business lines.
* **Stakeholder Engagement:** Act as the primary point of contact for senior stakeholders, translating business needs into actionable data initiatives and ensuring expectations are met through clear communication and robust reporting.
* **Performance Metrics and Continuous Improvement:** Define and monitor KPIs (delivery velocity, data quality, team productivity, stakeholder satisfaction) to drive process optimization and operational excellence.
* **Innovation:** Champion a culture of innovation, leveraging Azure/Databricks capabilities, Lakehouse architecture, Delta Lake, and AI/ML, to deliver impactful, scalable data solutions and products for International Banking.
  

  

**Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We'd love to work with you if you have:****Education:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Master’s degree (e.g., MBA, MS in Data Science) or advanced certifications (e.g., Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), SAFe Program Consultant (SPC), PMP) strongly preferred.

  

**Experience:**
* Minimum 10 years of progressive experience in Agile project management, data product delivery, and data strategy within banking or financial services.
* At least 5 years in a senior leadership role overseeing Agile Delivery Managers, Project Managers, and cross\-functional data teams.
* Demonstrated success delivering data solutions and data products on Azure/Databricks (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, pipelines), including leadership of Data Ops, Data Ingestion, and Data Provisioning functions.
* Proven track record of implementing governance and compliance frameworks for data products, ensuring adherence to international regulations (e.g., GDPR, Basel III, MiFID II).
* Extensive experience engaging with C\-level stakeholders, translating business needs into actionable data initiatives, and driving stakeholder alignment.
* Strong background in planning and facilitation services for technical teams, optimizing workflows, and resolving impediments.

  

**Skills \& Competencies:**
* Expert knowledge of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) and modern data engineering on Azure/Databricks, including the Lakehouse architecture, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, declarative/Lakeflow pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, and data governance.
* Exceptional leadership and mentoring abilities, with a focus on developing high\-performing Agile Delivery Managers and Project Managers.
* Strategic thinking and planning skills, with the ability to shape and execute data strategy and drive innovation.
* Advanced stakeholder management and communication skills, capable of influencing senior executives and global teams.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills in complex, high\-pressure en

Requisition ID: 274773
  

  

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high\-performing culture.

  

**The Team**


Global Wealth Banking and Markets Engineering (GWBMT) is the fast\-moving, award\-winning technology engine that powers Scotiabank's Wealth and Capital Markets businesses.


The Platform Engineering organization provides the foundational technology platforms and cloud services that enable application teams to innovate rapidly, securely, and at scale. Our portfolio includes enterprise Kubernetes platforms spanning on\-premises and Google Cloud environments, Cloud Enablement Services, Kafka as a Service, Airflow as a Service, Fine\-Grained Access Management capabilities, and future developer platform offerings that accelerate application modernization and cloud adoption.

  

**The Role**


We are seeking a Director Platform Product Owner to lead the product strategy, roadmap, adoption, and delivery of a portfolio of enterprise platform products that serve hundreds of engineers and mission\-critical applications across the bank.


This role sits at the intersection of technology, product management, engineering, and business strategy. The successful candidate will be responsible for defining and evolving platform products that enable cloud adoption, application modernization, developer productivity, security, and operational excellence.


As a senior product leader, you will partner closely with Platform Engineering, Architecture, Security, Infrastructure, and application development teams to ensure our platforms deliver measurable business value, exceptional user experiences, and scalable solutions that meet the needs of a rapidly evolving enterprise landscape.


You will act as the voice of the engineering customer while balancing engineering priorities, platform sustainability, risk management, and strategic technology objectives.


**Is this role right for you? In this role you will:**

* Define and execute the strategic vision, roadmap, and lifecycle management of a portfolio of platform engineering products and services.
* Develop product strategies that accelerate cloud adoption, platform standardization, application modernization, and engineering productivity.
* Identify emerging customer needs and market trends to drive innovation and platform evolution.
* Establish product success metrics, adoption goals, customer satisfaction targets, and business outcomes.
* Prioritize investments and roadmap initiatives based on business value, engineering impact, risk reduction, and operational efficiency.

* Fine\-Grained Access Management Platforms
* Developer Platform Capabilities and Self\-Service Engineering Solutions

  

***2\. Customer Engagement \& Platform Adoption***

  

* Act as the primary advocate for platform consumers across GBM and enterprise engineering teams.
* Build deep understanding of customer journeys, pain points, and platform adoption barriers.
* Drive platform onboarding strategies and self\-service experiences that improve developer productivity.
* Partner with application teams to identify modernization opportunities and accelerate cloud migration initiatives.
* Lead customer advisory forums, feedback programs, and adoption reviews to continually improve platform offerings.
* Establish product analytics frameworks and measurable indicators to track platform utilization, customer outcomes, productivity gains, and business value realization.

  

***3\. Technical Product Ownership***

  

* Translate strategic objectives into clear product roadmaps, capabilities, requirements, and delivery plans.
* Collaborate with architects and engineering teams to define platform capabilities, service offerings, APIs, and user experiences.
* Ensure platform products align with enterprise architecture standards, security requirements, and regulatory obligations.
* Define service offerings, operating models, support models, and service\-level objectives (SLOs) for platform products.
* Champion platform engineering principles, self\-service capabilities, automation, and developer experience improvements.
* Establish service consumption metrics, cost transparency models, showback/chargeback capabilities, and platform ROI measures.

  

***4\. Delivery Leadership \& Execution***

  

* Lead the planning and execution of platform product initiatives from ideation through delivery and adoption.
* Partner with engineering leaders to balance feature development, platform reliability, technical debt reduction, and operational excellence.
* Drive agile product delivery practices, roadmap governance, backlog prioritization, and release planning.
* Track delivery performance and ensure successful execution of strategic initiatives across multiple platform teams.
* Manage dependencies, risks, and stakeholder expectations across a complex enterprise environment.

  

***5\. Platform Reliability, Security \& Operational Excellence***

  

* Define and monitor key platform performance indicators, including availability, reliability, scalability, security, adoption, and customer satisfaction.
* Partner with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Security, and Operations teams to improve platform resiliency and operational maturity.
* Ensure security controls, access governance, and compliance requirements are embedded within platform services.
* Drive continual improvement initiatives focused on automation, observability, service health, and cost optimization.

* Own the end\-to\-end platform user experience across onboarding, self\-service workflows, documentation, observability, support engagement, and lifecycle management.
